english.title: PHV operator who has ceased to operate fail to preserve records - London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a London private hire vehicle and having ceased to use an operating centre specified in your licence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), failed to preserve

(A)_[a record, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RECORD..)]_
(B)_[records, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RECORDS..)]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section4(4) and (5)of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.
